ios.desc:
Harvest Bowl is a macro tracker and meal builder for athletes who want simple, high-protein meals that still hit their numbers.

Build bowl-style meals in seconds, set exact grams or calories for each ingredient, and watch your macros update instantly. No spreadsheets, no guessing, no complicated recipe math.

Whether you’re cutting, bulking, or maintaining, Harvest Bowl makes it easy to stay on top of your protein, carbs, fats and calories every day.

FEATURES

• Fast macro tracker – log complete meals in a couple of taps
• Macro calculator – see protein, carbs, fats and calories update in real time
• Precision sliders – dial in exact grams or calories for each food
• Clean ingredient lists – meats, grains, veggies, sauces and more
• High-protein meal builder – build bowls your coach would actually approve
• Quick veggie & carb presets – add volume without doing math
• Save your go-to bowls – reuse your favorite meals with one tap
• Simple history – see what you ate and how it fit your macros

HOW IT WORKS
	1.	Start with an empty bowl.
	2.	Add a protein, carb and veggies from curated ingredient lists.
	3.	Use the slider to choose exact grams or calories.
	4.	Watch your macros and calories update instantly.
	5.	Save the bowl and reuse it on training days or busy weeks.

Perfect if you already use a calorie counter or macro tracking app but hate logging every little ingredient one by one. Harvest Bowl focuses on the way athletes actually eat: simple, repeatable, high-protein bowls.

BUILT FOR

• Athletes, lifters and runners who track macros
• High-protein and strength-training diets
• People who meal prep bowl-style lunches and dinners
• Anyone who wants a cleaner, faster macro tracker and meal planner

Fuel smarter. Stay consistent. Perform better — one bowl at a time with Harvest Bowl.

quotes.text:
I built a small iPhone app called Harvest Bowl. It helps you build meals using exact grams or calories and shows your macros instantly as you adjust portions.

I made it because I wanted a dead-simple way to put together meals without using a full tracking app or dealing with cluttered food databases. Just pick ingredients, slide to set the portion, and the numbers update immediately.

Features:
• Precision sliders for grams/calories
• Instant macros
• Clean ingredient lists
• Quick veggie presets
• Save your go-to bowls

I’d love feedback from the HN community — UX, performance, missing features, anything. This is a version 1 and I’m trying to keep it focused and disciplined.

App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/harvest-bowl/id6754568085
Website: https://harvestbowlapp.com
